=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3038-3052 (_inject_token_into_url) and lines 3074-3087 (_resolve_origin_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using command-scoped authentication.
  WHY: Tokens leak through subprocess arguments, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, Git diagnostics, and remote-URL output, while removing the extraHeader path leaves no safer fallback.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: line 585 (`_memory_force_tick_remote_url`) and lines 137-180 (`memory_ensure_branch`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory helpers embed tokens in URLs and replace authenticated Git calls with bare `git` invocations.
  WHY: Force-tick operations expose credentials, while `persist-credentials: false` leaves branch initialization and memory persistence unauthenticated and failing open.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-157, 240-247 (normalize_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and per-path limits were removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths to resolve credential-bearing files.
  WHY: Files such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, `.netrc`, and symlinked sensitive paths can be inlined into model prompts.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 (codex invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose runs Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` after removing the model-provider broker while ambient credentials remain available.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can read or exfiltrate credentials and mutate the workspace outside the prior brokered, read-only boundary.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 135-140 (end of file after diff); the entire model_provider_broker_* family that previously spanned lines 141-522 was removed | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Broker lifecycle and execution APIs were deleted while live workflows and scripts still invoke them.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with `command not found` before Codex launches, removing the loopback URL, ACL-isolated home, unprivileged execution, and process isolation.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 30-66 (option parser) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed from the guard parser while `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553` still passes it.
  WHY: Editor-isolated runs exit with an unknown-option error before launching the editor.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 175-180 and the deleted isolated-user/process-group cleanup functions | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user detection, process-group tracking, privileged killing, survivor verification, and zombie handling were removed.
  WHY: Killing the sudo wrapper can leave nobody-owned editor descendants alive, allowing orphaned processes to retain credentials or files and making cleanup report success incorrectly.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 493-498 and 947-947 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` approval/state-machine helpers were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes fail, review-blocked terminal decisions remain pending, and successor-issue and approval-marker operations cannot run.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 766-772 (REST jq transform), 833-921 (GraphQL transform) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval logic cannot bind producer comments or authorize approvers, so approvals remain pending even if the deleted helpers are restored.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 29-35 (usage), 85-143 (parser), 258-264 (hardcoded base_url) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and `base_url` was hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` while callers still pass the option.
  WHY: Config generation exits on an unknown argument, and the hardcoded URL bypasses the loopback broker and its URL allowlisting.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 599-628, 770-925 (force-tick) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick clone, `ls-remote`, and push operations use bare Git calls after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: With credential-free HTTPS origins, memory operations fail with authentication errors and fail-open guards leave the ai-memory cache unavailable.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 and 86-141 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication variables are scoped to one workflow step and are not available to later memory-helper operations.
  WHY: Later bare Git calls use a credential-free origin, so lineage finalization and ai-memory branch operations cannot authenticate.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-37 (test imports) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed from `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError`, preventing the module and dependent suites from running.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 (new STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore guard depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but the workflow never sets or exports them.
  WHY: The guard is dead code, so self-repository implement runs can overwrite branch-owned helper changes with staged `SCRIPT_REF` copies.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 100 (patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config body) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic config patch writes to `${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml` instead of the `CODEX_HOME`-scoped configuration.
  WHY: It can clobber the runner-global config while leaving the active per-invocation agent configuration unpatched.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 540-716 (emit_context body) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file and overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`, inflating model context and violating the documented output bound.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 569-602 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow's staged Telegram helper may depend on deleted `gh_helpers.sh` APIs, while the new validation gate hard-fails instead of soft-skipping.
  WHY: Consumer-repository PR-close Telegram flows can exit with command-not-found failures rather than preserving the documented no-op behavior.
